617:t_001:55.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「The feelings of the people of Earth, who don't flinch even in the face of a giant enemy, are pushing $c forward right now!」

617:t_001:56.en:
$$刹那$$
「And humanity moves forward! Past those like you who block the future!」

617:t_001:58.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Then go ahead and show us. If you do, we'll take you on.」

617:t_001:59.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「I'll carve it into your bodies until even incompetents who can't understand our words get the message.」

617:t_001:60.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Like I'd flinch at threats like that now!」

617:t_001:61.en:
$$キリコ$$
「I have no intention of obeying you.」

617:t_001:62.en:
$$ランド$$
「Fine by me! We came here raring to go from the start!」

617:t_001:64.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Today is the last day of the $$新地球皇国$$!」

617:t_001:65.en:
$$バサラ$$
「It's the start of a stage that sets our souls on fire!!」

617:t_002:0.en:
$$キラ$$
(I'm coming to save you now, $$カガリ$$...)

617:t_002:1.en:
$$ゼロ$$
($$ナナリー$$...! Just wait a little longer for me!)

617:t_002:2.en:
$$刹那$$
($$マリナ・イスマイール$$... The world needs a person like you.)

617:t_002:3.en:
$$スズネ$$
「$n...! Is your body all right!?」

617:t_002:4.en:
$n
「So far, no $$血塗られた眼$$ have shown up!」

617:t_002:5.en:
$n
(I don't know how the $$霊子吸収システム$$ in that Imperial Palace relates to the $$血塗られた眼$$...)

617:t_002:6.en:
$n
(But all I can do now is keep advancing...! Staking everything I have!)

617:t_002:7.en:
$n
「Here we come, $$エルーナルーナ$$! $$尸空#pilot$$, $$バルビエル$$! First, we drag you out!」

617:t_003:1.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「So an annoying one showed up too.」

617:t_004:1.en:
$$カレン$$
「That guy...! Did he come to back the Empire!?」

617:t_004:2.en:
$$ガドライト#pilot$$
「I told you. Right now I'm neither with the $$ジェミニス$$ nor the $$サイデリアル$$.」

617:t_004:5.en:
$$ガドライト#pilot$$
「But before that, I have to thank you.」

617:t_004:7.en:
$$ガドライト#pilot$$
「It's true you killed $$アンナロッタ$$.」

617:t_004:9.en:
$$ガドライト#pilot$$
「But you didn't lay a hand on the $$ジェミニス$$ around her, or on the baby in her belly.」

617:t_004:10.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「The mission I received was, should the $$ジェミニス$$ defy Heaven's will, to eliminate the last woman, $$アンナロッタ・ストールス$$.」

617:t_004:11.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「Anything beyond that is no concern of mine.」

617:t_004:12.en:
$$ガドライト#pilot$$
「Thanks to that, the daughters of $$アンナロッタ$$ and me... the hope of the $$ジェミナイド$$ were born. Twins, no less.」

617:t_004:13.en:
$$ガドライト#pilot$$
「I named them $$アンナ$$ and $$ロッタ$$. When those girls grow up, the $$ジェミナイド$$ will be able to pass its blood on to the next generation.」

617:t_004:16.en:
$$ガドライト#pilot$$
「But listen! Mission or not, I won't forgive you for killing $$アンナロッタ$$!!」

617:t_004:17.en:
$$ガドライト#pilot$$
「I'll crush you! You... and the $$サイデリアル$$! And then...!」

617:t_004:19.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「In the end, you're a half-baked Reactor who couldn't take the $$いがみ合う双子$$ to the true Third Stage.」

617:t_004:20.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「It's presumptuous for a man like that to defy us.」

617:t_004:21.en:
$$ガドライト#pilot$$
「Fine, $$バルビエル$$. Sooner or later I was bound to clash with a lapdog like you too!」

617:t_004:22.en:
$$ガドライト#pilot$$
「And of course $$エルーナルーナ$$ and $$アウストラリス$$ too!」

617:t_004:23.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Is that why you stole the spear, $$ガドライト#pilot$$?」

617:t_004:25.en:
$$ツィーネ$$
「That's right. The spear you have, the one that warps causality, was kept by the $$サイデリアル$$...」

617:t_004:26.en:
$$ツィーネ$$
「It was him... $$ガドライト・メオンサム$$... who handed it to $$レナード・テスタロッサ$$.」

617:t_004:27.en:
$$ガドライト#pilot$$
「$$クィーン$$, huh. So in the end you sided with $c.」

617:t_004:28.en:
$$ツィーネ$$
「When all is said and done, I love this planet too.」

617:t_004:29.en:
$$ガドライト#pilot$$
「Heh... Humans... No matter what the situation, the feeling of cherishing the planet you were born on never goes away.」

617:t_004:30.en:
$$桂$$
「It seems $$ガドライト#pilot$$ was also the one leaking the Empire's inner workings to $$ツィーネ$$.」

617:t_004:31.en:
$$デュオ$$
「He's an ex-$$サイデリアル$$. So he had connections in that area, huh.」

617:t_004:32.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「OK, $$ガドライト#pilot$$. You don't have a $$スフィア$$ anymore, so we've got no attachment to you either.」

617:t_004:33.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「A pity. If only you had more power.」

617:t_004:34.en:
$$ガドライト#pilot$$
「Shut up. With or without a $$スフィア$$, don't think I'm the same as when I was a drunk wallowing in the swamp of resignation.」

617:t_004:36.en:
$$ガドライト#pilot$$
「Don't run your mouth, $n. I'm doing this because I want to.」

617:t_004:37.en:
$$ガドライト#pilot$$
「But I'll say thanks. Your being here made me remember how to struggle on.」

617:t_004:38.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「$$ガドライト・メオンサム$$... So you have regained your pride.」

617:t_004:40.en:
$$ガドライト#pilot$$
「Brace yourselves, $$サイデリアル$$! I'll make you feel the rage of a man you've kept robbing!」

617:t_004:41.en:
$$ガドライト#pilot$$
「For my dead wife! For $$アンナ$$ and $$ロッタ$$... and for the $$ジェミナイド$$' tomorrow! I'll crush you!」

617:t_005:1.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「Only $$皇帝アウストラリス$$ remains!」

617:t_005:2.en:
$$グラハム$$
「The ruler of the $$新地球皇国$$...! So he finally shows himself!」

617:t_006:1.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Don't tell me that sphere is...!」

617:t_007:0.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「That's right. That is $$皇帝アウストラリス$$.」

617:t_007:1.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「You could say that orb is him, himself.」

617:t_007:2.en:
$$ランド$$
「Still haven't learned your lesson, coming back like that!」

617:t_007:3.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Damn! He means to regenerate his machine with the $$スフィア$$s' $$次元力$$!」

617:t_007:4.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Too bad, $$セツコ$$! If you hadn't been swayed by pointless sentiment, you should have finished me off back then!」

617:t_007:5.en:
$$セツコ$$
「$$バルビエル$$! You're still doing this!」

617:t_007:6.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Now, $$アウストラリス$$! We'll buy you the time! In the meantime...」

617:t_008:0.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「$$アウストラリス$$! What are you doing!?」

617:t_008:1.en:
$$マリ$$
「That guy! He shot his own ally!?」

617:t_008:3.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Don't tell me you...! Our...」
